text:
Amanda (CS): Hey team, customer 'BrightMap' hitting 403 on both generation and embeddings right after their SSO token refresh. They say it worked, then a rotation happened and now only embeddings succeed.
Ben (oncall): Can you paste the failing request (headers + error) and whether this is an SSO-created service key or a provisioner/imported key?
Amanda (CS): Repro from customer (sanitized):
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi...' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Response:
```json
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"token missing required scope: generation"}
```
Amanda (CS): Token introspect (they ran):
```json
{"active":true,"client":"brightmap-sso","scp":"embeddings"}
```
Amanda (CS): So the scope claim only contains "embeddings" after rotation. This was a SCIM SSO flow (our provisioner ingested their group->scopes mapping).
Claire (eng): Hm. Not the usual 'missing rerank' pattern. Could be the provisioner import truncated the scopes string. Do we have a recent change to the importer or a header size rule in the sidecar?
Dave (eng-infra): We deployed a small change to the ingress sidecar last week that normalizes scopes header and splits on spaces for legacy tokens. If the provisioner wrote a comma-separated list but the CSV had a newline or long field, our parser could truncate at 256 chars. I'm looking now.
Ben (oncall): Amanda, can you repro locally with a SCIM-style token that has a long scope list? If we can reproduce we can patch quickly and advise customer.
Amanda (CS): I did a quick repro by creating a test token with scopes: generation,embeddings,rerank,search,policy,metrics,debug-ops,extra-flag-1,extra-flag-2,... (long). After going through the provisioner import path, the introspect shows only "embeddings" in scp.
Claire (eng): Confirmed: provisioner CSV handler has a trim on the scope column and silently removes characters after 255. When the truncation falls inside the first token list it can leave a partial scope string that the downstream normalizer drops, resulting in a single surviving scope.
Dave (eng-infra): Patch PR up: remove the hard trim in CSV importer and add quoting-aware parsing + unit. Rolling to canary now. Deploy id: deploy-bot#r-2023-3141.
deploy-bot: rollout started for provisioner-importer v2.7.3 -> canary cluster
Ben (oncall): For the customer workaround, suggest they create a short-lived console key (Console > API Keys > Create key) with explicit scopes 'generation, embeddings, rerank' and switch the app to use it until we fix the import. Also recommend they shorten the scope column values in their SCIM mapping as a temporary mitigation.
Amanda (CS): I sent the workaround steps to BrightMap and opened a follow-up ticket to remove the broken key from their tenant. They confirmed temporary key works and generation is restored. :thumbsup:
Claire (eng): Action items: 1) roll fix to provisioner importer (PR linked in eng-infra channel), 2) add importer telemetry to detect truncated fields, 3) add end-to-end test for long scope lists.
Dave (eng-infra): Will monitor canary for 30m and then promote. If anyone sees related regressions @eng-infra.
Ben (oncall): Marking this as customer-impacting but mitigated. Please add the incident label in the ticket and include reproduction steps and the CSV sample that triggered it.
Amanda (CS): Will attach their sanitized CSV and the repro curl to the ticket. Thanks all!
